title: Tianhuang City
summary: Xiao Yan and Lin Yan reach Tianhuang City, where Liu Qing's Liu Clan runs a Wormhole to the Pill Region. The region is ruled by the Burning Flame Valley, which holds the Nine Dragon Lightning Flame and the Sky Fire Three Mysterious Changes. Valley Chief Tang wants a high-tier alchemist, and Elder Chi Huo says whichever clan provides one will run the Wormhole for three years. The Cheng Clan brings Zeng Xiu, a sixth-tier alchemist of the Pill Tower, but Xiao Yan, going by Yan Xiao, beats him in a contest of Spiritual Strength. Elder Chi Huo takes him to the Burning Flame Valley, where Tang Zhen wants a Seventh-Tier High-Grade Pill refined. Only Master Huan, with his Sky Cold Flame, and Xiao Yan, with a Heavenly Flame no one can place, withstand the Nine Dragon Lightning Flame. As his reward, Xiao Yan asks for the Sky Fire Three Mysterious Changes.
events: Xiao Yan and Lin Yan arrive in Tianhuang City.
Lin Yan explains the Burning Flame Valley and warns against using the Sky Fire Three Mysterious Changes.
Elder Chi Huo sets a contest between the Liu Clan and the Cheng Clan for the Wormhole.
Xiao Yan meets Liu Qing and Liu Fei again.
Xiao Yan beats Zeng Xiu and wins the Wormhole for the Liu Clan.
At the Burning Flame Valley, Tang Huo Er doubts him and Tang Zhen explains the pill.
Master Huan and Xiao Yan pass the Nine Dragon Lightning Flame test.
Xiao Yan names the Sky Fire Three Mysterious Changes as his price.
